  {"step":2,"file":"fuzzing/format_command_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":37,"var":"new_str","code":"new_str = malloc(size+1);","note":"The raw bytes are copied into a heap buffer and NUL-terminated before formatting."},

  {"step":5,"file":"hiredis.c","function":"redisvFormatCommand","line":357,"var":"curarg","code":"len = strlen(c+1);","note":"For %s arguments, the formatter dereferences the next vararg as a C string; if the attacker-controlled format consumes more %s directives than provided arguments, it reads an invalid pointer and crashes."},
